recipes.title: One-pot spaghetti with meat sauce
recipes.blurb: Everything cooks in one pot, pasta and sauce together

steps.text: In a large pot over medium-high heat, brown the beef and onion, breaking it up, until no pink is left.
Stir in the garlic for 1 minute. Spoon off any extra fat.
Add the marinara, water, Italian seasoning and salt. Bring to a boil.
Add the spaghetti and push it down under the sauce.
Turn the heat to low, cover, and simmer. Stir every few minutes so it doesn’t stick.
When the pasta is tender, turn off the heat and let it sit uncovered to thicken.
Serve with grated Parmesan on top.

recipes.title: Spaghetti carbonara
recipes.blurb: Silky egg, pecorino and crispy pancetta, no cream

steps.text: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil.
Cook the pancetta in a big skillet over medium heat until crisp. Turn off the heat.
Whisk the eggs, yolks, pecorino and pepper in a bowl into a thick paste.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente. Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the hot spaghetti in the skillet with the pancetta and its fat, off the heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and toss fast, adding pasta water a splash at a time until creamy.
Serve right away with more pecorino and pepper.

recipes.title: Cacio e pepe
recipes.blurb: Rome’s three-ingredient classic: pecorino, pepper, pasta

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water, using only about 3 quarts so the water stays starchy.
Cook the spaghetti until 1 minute short of al dente.
Toast the pepper and butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 1 minute.
Scoop 1 cup pasta water into the skillet, then move the spaghetti in with tongs.
Take the pan off the heat. Add the pecorino a handful at a time, tossing hard until creamy.
Loosen with more pasta water if needed and serve right away.

recipes.title: Spaghetti aglio e olio
recipes.blurb: Garlic, olive oil and chili flakes, ready in 20 minutes

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
While it cooks, warm the oil and sliced garlic in a large skillet over low heat.
Cook gently until the garlic is pale gold, not brown. Add the pepper flakes.
Add the spaghetti and ½ cup pasta water. Toss over medium heat until glossy.
Stir in the parsley, taste for salt, and serve.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.blurb: Buttery, creamy and cheesy, the Italian-American favorite

steps.text: Boil the fettuccine in salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream and simmer until it just starts to thicken.
Turn the heat to low. Whisk in the Parmesan and nutmeg until smooth.
Toss in the fettuccine, adding pasta water a splash at a time until the sauce coats it.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with parsley, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Penne alla vodka
recipes.blurb: Creamy blush tomato sauce with a little pepper flake heat

steps.text: Cook the onion in olive oil over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomato paste and pepper flakes. Stir for 2 minutes until the paste darkens.
Pour in the vodka and let it bubble until nearly gone.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Simmer, stirring now and then.
Meanwhile boil the penne in salted water until al dente. Save a cup of pasta water, then drain.
Stir the cream and Parmesan into the sauce, then toss with the penne, adding pasta water to loosen.
Top with basil and serve.

recipes.title: Tagliatelle with Bolognese
recipes.blurb: Slow-simmered meat ragu with milk and wine, weekend comfort

steps.text: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven. Cook the pancetta, onion, celery and carrot over medium heat until soft.
Add the beef and pork. Cook, breaking it up, until no pink is left.
Pour in the wine and simmer until it has mostly evaporated.
Add the milk and simmer until absorbed, stirring often.
Stir in the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a bare simmer.
Cover partly and cook on low, stirring now and then, until rich and thick.
Boil the tagliatelle in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Toss the pasta with the ragu and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Bucatini all’amatriciana
recipes.blurb: Tomato, guanciale and pecorino with a little heat

steps.text: Cook the guanciale in the oil in a large skillet over medium heat until the fat renders and edges crisp.
Stir in the pepper flakes, then the wine. Let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, break them up, and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Meanwhile boil the bucatini in salted water until al dente. Save 1 cup pasta water, then drain.
Toss the bucatini in the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Add half the pecorino, toss, and serve with the rest on top.

recipes.title: Spaghetti and meatballs
recipes.blurb: Tender beef-pork meatballs simmered in simple tomato sauce

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes. Mix with the meats, egg, Parmesan, 2 garlic, parsley and salt.
Roll into about 18 meatballs, handling the meat lightly.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a Dutch oven, turning, then set aside. Cook the last garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt and bring to a simmer. Nestle the meatballs in.
Cover partly and simmer gently. Meatballs are done at 160°F inside.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Serve the spaghetti topped with sauce, meatballs and more Parmesan.

recipes.title: Pesto pasta with green beans and potatoes
recipes.blurb: The Ligurian way: trofie-style pasta, tender potato and basil pesto

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Blend the basil, pine nuts, garlic, Parmesan, oil and ½ tsp salt into a coarse pesto.
Boil the potatoes alone for 5 minutes.
Add the pasta and green beans to the same pot. Cook until the pasta is al dente.
Save ½ cup of cooking water, then drain everything.
Toss with the pesto and enough cooking water to make it creamy. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Classic meat lasagna
recipes.blurb: Layers of meat sauce, ricotta and mozzarella, the Sunday dinner

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the noodles in salted water until barely tender, then drain.
Brown the beef, sausage and onion until no pink is left. Add the garlic, marinara and tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Mix the ricotta, egg, half the Parmesan, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Spread sauce in a 9x13 dish. Layer noodles, ricotta, mozzarella and sauce, repeating three times.
Finish with sauce, mozzarella and the rest of the Parmesan. Cover with foil.
Bake covered, then uncover and bake until bubbly and browned.
Let it rest so the layers set before cutting.

recipes.title: Spinach and mushroom lasagna
recipes.blurb: Creamy white sauce, spinach, mushrooms and three cheeses

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the noodles until barely tender, then drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk. Simmer until thick. Add nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Sauté the mushrooms and garlic in a dry skillet until browned. Mix in the spinach and ricotta.
Spread white sauce in a 9x13 dish. Layer noodles, spinach filling, mozzarella and sauce, three layers.
Top with sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil.
Bake covered for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake until golden.
Let it rest before cutting.

recipes.title: Baked ziti
recipes.blurb: Cheesy ziti in meaty tomato sauce, easy for a crowd

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the ziti 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Brown the beef and onion in a large pot until no pink is left. Add the garlic, marinara, tomatoes and seasoning and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir the ziti into the sauce. Mix the ricotta with half the Parmesan and a pinch of salt.
Spread half the pasta in a 9x13 dish, dot with ricotta, then add the rest of the pasta.
Top with mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan. Cover with foil.
Bake covered for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake until browned and bubbly.
Let it stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Ricotta-stuffed shells
recipes.blurb: Jumbo shells filled with ricotta and spinach in marinara

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the shells 2 minutes short of tender, then drain and cool on a tray.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, 1 cup mozzarella, half the Parmesan, egg, garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spread half the marinara in a 9x13 dish.
Fill each shell with about 2 tablespoons of filling. Set them in the sauce, open side up.
Spoon the rest of the sauce over, top with mozzarella and Parmesan, and cover with foil.
Bake covered for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake until bubbling.

recipes.title: Baked manicotti
recipes.blurb: Tubes of pasta stuffed with ricotta, baked in red sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the manicotti 3 minutes short of tender, then drain on a tray.
Mix the ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, half the Parmesan, egg, parsley, salt and pepper.
Stir the marinara and tomato sauce together. Spread 1 cup in a 9x13 dish.
Spoon the filling into the shells using a zip bag with a corner snipped. Lay them in the dish.
Cover with the rest of the sauce, then the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil.
Bake covered for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake until browned.

recipes.title: Lasagna roll-ups
recipes.blurb: Individual lasagna spirals, easy to serve and portion

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the noodles until just tender, then drain and lay flat on a tray.
Brown the beef until no pink is left, then drain. Stir in the marinara.
Mix the ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, half the Parmesan, egg, seasoning and a pinch of salt.
Spread meat sauce in a 9x13 dish. Spread 3 tablespoons filling on each noodle and roll up.
Set the rolls seam side down in the dish. Top with sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan, then cover with foil.
Bake covered for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake until bubbly.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.blurb: Crispy baked eggplant slices layered with sauce and mozzarella

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Salt the eggplant slices and let them sit on towels to draw out moisture.
Salt and drain the slices, then pat dry.
Mix the breadcrumbs, half the Parmesan and the Italian seasoning. Dip slices in egg, then crumbs.
Brush with oil and bake on two lined sheet pans, flipping once, until golden.
Lower the oven to 375°F. Spread sauce in a baking dish, then layer eggplant, sauce and mozzarella.
Top with the remaining cheese. Bake until bubbling and golden.
Rest 5 minutes and scatter with basil.

recipes.title: Baked rigatoni with sausage
recipes.blurb: Italian sausage, tomato sauce and melty cheese in one dish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the rigatoni 2 minutes short of the package time, then drain.
Brown the sausage and onion in a large pot, breaking it up, until cooked through. Add the garlic.
Stir in the marinara, tomatoes and cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix in the rigatoni and half the mozzarella, then pour into a 9x13 dish.
Top with the rest of the mozzarella and the Parmesan.
Bake uncovered until browned and bubbling.
Let it cool 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cheese tortellini bake
recipes.blurb: Fridge tortellini baked with sauce and mozzarella, no boiling

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Stir the marinara, water, diced tomatoes, seasoning and a pinch of salt in a 9x13 dish.
Fold in the tortellini, spinach and half the mozzarella.
Cover tightly with foil.
Bake covered until the tortellini is tender.
Uncover, add the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake uncovered until the cheese is melted and golden.

recipes.title: Chicken broccoli Alfredo bake
recipes.blurb: Creamy Alfredo pasta with chicken and broccoli under crispy cheese

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the penne 2 minutes short of tender, adding the broccoli for the last minute. Drain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in the oil until golden and no longer pink, 6 to 8 minutes.
Melt the butter, cook the garlic 30 seconds, then whisk in the flour. Slowly add the milk and cream.
Simmer, stirring, until thick. Whisk in the Parmesan.
Stir the pasta, broccoli and chicken into the sauce. Pour into a 9x13 dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake until bubbly and golden. The chicken should reach 165°F.

recipes.title: Margherita pizza
recipes.blurb: Chewy homemade crust, tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and 1 tsp salt. Stir in the warm water and 1 tbsp oil until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead on a floured counter until smooth, about 8 minutes. Put it in an oiled bowl and cover.
Let the dough rise until doubled.
Heat the oven with a pizza stone or upside-down sheet pan to 500°F. Mix the tomatoes with ½ tsp salt.
Divide the dough in 2, stretch each into a 12-inch round, and top with sauce and mozzarella.
Slide onto the hot pan and bake until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles.
Scatter with basil and drizzle with the remaining oil.

recipes.title: Pepperoni pizza
recipes.blurb: The family favorite with a crisp golden crust

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Stir in the warm water and oil, then knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled.
Heat the oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside. Divide the dough in 2 and stretch to 12-inch rounds.
Top each with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake on the hot pan until the crust is deep golden and cheese is bubbly.
Let it rest 2 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: White pizza with ricotta and garlic
recipes.blurb: No red sauce: garlic oil, ricotta and mozzarella

steps.text: Heat the oven to 500°F with a sheet pan inside.
Warm the oil and garlic in a small pan for 1 minute, then take it off the heat.
Stretch the dough into a 14-inch round on parchment. Brush with garlic oil.
Dot with ricotta, then cover with mozzarella, Parmesan, oregano and pepper flakes.
Slide onto the hot pan. Bake until crisp and browned at the edges.
Finish with black pepper and slice.

recipes.title: Sicilian sheet-pan pizza
recipes.blurb: Thick, airy, crisp-bottomed square pizza for a crowd

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Stir in the water until sticky, then knead 5 minutes.
Oil a 13x18 sheet pan with 2 tbsp oil. Press the dough in, cover, and let it rise.
Let rise until puffy and doubled.
Heat the oven to 450°F. Mix the tomatoes with oregano and a pinch of salt.
Spread the sauce on, leaving a border. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake on the lowest rack until the cheese is bubbly and the bottom is golden.
Rest 5 minutes, then cut into squares.

recipes.title: Rosemary sea-salt focaccia
recipes.blurb: Dimpled, olive-oil rich bread with a crisp, golden base

steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast, sugar and 2 tsp salt in a large bowl. Mix in the water and 2 tbsp oil into a wet, sticky dough.
Cover and let it rise until doubled.
Pour 2 tbsp oil into a 9x13 pan. Turn the dough in, fold it over, and stretch it toward the corners.
Let it rest and puff up a bit.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Dimple the dough with oiled fingers, drizzle with oil, and scatter rosemary and sea salt.
Bake until deep golden.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: Cheesy garlic bread
recipes.blurb: Buttery garlic and parsley on crusty bread, with a melted cheese top

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Mix the butter, garlic, parsley, Parmesan and a pinch of salt.
Spread the butter on the cut sides of the bread and put them on a sheet pan.
Bake until the edges are golden.
Top with mozzarella and bake until melted and bubbly.
Bake until the cheese melts.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Tomato basil bruschetta
recipes.blurb: Grilled bread rubbed with garlic, topped with fresh tomatoes

steps.text: Mix the tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, 2 tbsp oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Let it sit.
Let the tomatoes sit to soak up flavor.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush the bread with the remaining oil.
Toast the slices on a sheet pan until golden, turning once.
Rub the warm toast with the cut side of the other garlic clove.
Spoon on the tomato mixture just before serving.

recipes.title: Cheese and pepperoni calzones
recipes.blurb: Folded pizza pockets with ricotta, mozzarella and pepperoni

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella, pepperoni, Parmesan and oregano.
Cut the dough into 4 and roll each into a 8-inch round.
Put filling on half of each round. Fold over, press the edges, and crimp with a fork.
Brush with egg and cut a small slit in each to let steam out.
Bake until deep golden brown.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Italian stromboli
recipes.blurb: Rolled pizza dough with salami, ham, provolone and peppers

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Roll the dough into a 12x16 rectangle on the parchment.
Layer the provolone, salami, ham, mozzarella and peppers, leaving a 1-inch border.
Roll up from the long side, pinch the seam and ends, and set seam side down.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with Italian seasoning, and cut 4 slits on top.
Bake until deep golden.
Rest 10 minutes, slice, and serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Garlic knots
recipes.blurb: Soft pizzeria-style knots brushed with garlic butter

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Roll the dough into a rectangle and cut it into 12 strips.
Roll each strip into a rope and tie into a loose knot. Tuck the ends under.
Cover the knots and let them puff up.
Bake until golden brown.
Stir the garlic into the melted butter with the parsley, Parmesan, oregano and salt.
Toss the hot knots in the garlic butter and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.blurb: Crispy breaded cutlets under marinara and melted mozzarella

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Pound the chicken to half-inch thick and season with the salt.
Set up three dishes: flour, beaten eggs, and panko mixed with Parmesan and Italian seasoning.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then the crumbs.
Fry the cutlets in the oil until golden on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Move the cutlets to a baking sheet. Top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake until the cheese melts and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Serve with spaghetti or a salad.

recipes.title: Chicken piccata
recipes.blurb: Pan-seared cutlets in a bright lemon-caper butter sauce

steps.text: Pound the chicken thin. Season with salt and pepper and dredge in the flour.
Brown the cutlets in the oil over medium-high heat, 3 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Add the broth and lemon juice to the pan, scraping up the browned bits.
Simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in the butter and capers until the sauce is glossy.
Return the chicken for 1 minute. It should be 165°F inside. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken marsala
recipes.blurb: Golden chicken and mushrooms in a rich marsala wine sauce

steps.text: Pound the chicken thin. Season with salt and pepper and dredge in the flour.
Brown the cutlets in the oil, 3 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Melt the butter in the pan. Cook the mushrooms until browned and the liquid is gone.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the marsala and broth.
Simmer until the sauce reduces by about a third.
Return the chicken to the pan and simmer 3 minutes. It should reach 165°F inside.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken cacciatore
recipes.blurb: Hunter-style chicken braised with peppers, tomatoes and wine

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Brown it skin side down in the oil in a Dutch oven, then set aside.
Brown the chicken well.
Cook the onion, peppers and mushrooms in the drippings until soft. Add the garlic.
Pour in the wine and scrape the pan. Stir in the tomatoes and oregano.
Return the chicken to the pot and spoon some sauce over. Cover and simmer on low.
Simmer until the chicken is tender and reaches 175°F.
Serve over polenta, rice or pasta.

recipes.title: Sausage and peppers
recipes.blurb: Italian sausage with sweet peppers and onion, the street-fair classic

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Put the peppers, onion and garlic on a large sheet pan. Toss with the oil, oregano, salt and pepper.
Nestle the sausages among the vegetables.
Roast, turning the sausages and stirring halfway.
Check that the sausages reach 160°F inside. Roast a few more minutes if not.
Serve in rolls or over pasta.

recipes.title: Slow cooker Italian beef sandwiches
recipes.blurb: Tender shredded beef with pepperoncini, piled on crusty rolls

steps.text: Put the roast in a slow cooker. Sprinkle with the dressing mix.
Add the broth, garlic and pepperoncini with their juice.
Cover and cook on low until the beef is very tender.
Shred the beef with two forks and stir it back into the juices.
Let it soak up the juices.
Pile on split rolls, top with provolone, and broil until melted. Serve with extra juice.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan chicken
recipes.blurb: Seared chicken in garlic cream sauce with sun-dried tomatoes and spinach

steps.text: Season the chicken with the salt and pepper.
Sear in the oil over medium-high heat until golden, 5 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes in the pan for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth, cream, Parmesan and Italian seasoning. Simmer until it thickens.
Simmer until slightly thickened.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then return the chicken. It should reach 165°F inside.

recipes.title: Chicken saltimbocca
recipes.blurb: Chicken wrapped with prosciutto and sage, pan-seared in white wine

steps.text: Pound the chicken thin and season with pepper. Lay 3 sage leaves on each, then wrap with 2 prosciutto slices.
Dust lightly with flour on both sides.
Cook in the oil over medium-high heat, prosciutto side down first, 3 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Add the wine and broth to the pan, scraping up the browned bits.
Simmer until reduced by half.
Whisk in the butter. Return the chicken, which should be 165°F inside, and spoon the sauce over.

recipes.title: Pork Milanese
recipes.blurb: Thin crispy breaded pork cutlets with lemon and arugula

steps.text: Pound the pork to a quarter-inch thick. Season with the salt.
Set out three dishes: flour, eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing them on.
Fry in hot oil until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side, in batches.
Check that the pork reaches 145°F inside. Drain on paper towels.
Serve topped with arugula dressed with a squeeze of lemon and a wedge on the side.

recipes.title: Baked Italian meatballs
recipes.blurb: Easy oven meatballs, no frying, great for subs or pasta

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix the meats, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, garlic, parsley, seasoning and salt with your hands.
Roll into about 24 meatballs and set them on the pan.
Bake until browned and cooked through. They should reach 160°F inside.
Simmer the meatballs in the warm marinara for a few minutes.
Serve with pasta, on rolls or on their own.

recipes.title: Beef braciole
recipes.blurb: Rolled flank steak stuffed with cheese and herbs, simmered in sauce

steps.text: Lay the steak flat. Cover with prosciutto, then garlic, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper.
Roll it up from the short side and tie with kitchen twine.
Brown the roll on all sides in the oil in a Dutch oven. Set aside.
Cook the onion in the same pot. Add the wine and scrape the pan, then add the tomatoes.
Return the roll and bring to a gentle simmer. Cover.
Simmer on low, turning once, until the beef is very tender.
Rest the roll, remove the twine, and slice into rounds. Serve with the sauce.

recipes.title: Minestrone
recipes.blurb: Hearty vegetable soup with beans and pasta

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil over medium heat until softened.
Cook the vegetables until soft.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds. Stir in the tomatoes, broth, Italian seasoning and 1 tsp salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer.
Add the beans, zucchini and pasta.
Simmer until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach, season with salt and pepper, and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Pasta e fagioli
recipes.blurb: Rustic pasta and white bean soup, thick and cozy

steps.text: Cook the pancetta in the oil in a Dutch oven until crisp.
Add the onion, carrots and celery. Cook until soft, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, broth and rosemary. Mash about half a cup of beans against the side of the pot.
Simmer to blend the flavors.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, stirring often.
Remove the rosemary and serve with Parmesan and a drizzle of oil.

recipes.title: Italian wedding soup
recipes.blurb: Tiny meatballs, spinach and pasta in a clear savory broth

steps.text: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, 1 garlic clove and ½ tsp salt. Roll into small marble-sized balls.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil until soft. Add the remaining garlic.
Add the broth and remaining salt and bring to a boil.
Drop in the meatballs and the pasta.
Simmer until the meatballs hit 160°F inside and the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Zuppa Toscana
recipes.blurb: Sausage, potatoes and kale in a creamy broth

steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium heat, breaking it up. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Cook the onion in the drippings until soft, then add the garlic and pepper flakes.
Add the broth and potatoes and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale and sausage and simmer until the kale is tender.
Simmer the kale.
Stir in the cream, heat through, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Creamy tomato basil soup
recipes.blurb: Smooth tomato soup, perfect with grilled cheese

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pot. Cook the onion until soft, about 6 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, broth, sugar and half the basil.
Bring to a boil, then simmer.
Blend until smooth with an immersion blender, or in batches in a blender.
Stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Top with the remaining basil and serve.

recipes.title: Tortellini and spinach soup
recipes.blurb: Cheese tortellini in garlicky broth, ready in 25 minutes

steps.text: Cook the onion and carrots in the oil until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth, tomatoes and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil.
Simmer to soften the carrots.
Add the tortellini.
Cook until the tortellini float and are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season with salt and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Mushroom risotto
recipes.blurb: Creamy arborio rice with browned mushrooms and Parmesan

steps.text: Warm the broth in a pot and keep it at a bare simmer.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a wide pot. Cook the mushrooms until browned, then set aside.
Melt another tbsp butter. Cook the shallot and garlic 2 minutes, then stir in the rice until the edges look clear.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring often, waiting until absorbed each time.
The rice should be creamy but still a little firm. Stir in the mushrooms, remaining butter and Parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with parsley, and serve at once.

recipes.title: Risotto alla Milanese
recipes.blurb: Golden saffron risotto, the classic partner for braised meats

steps.text: Warm the broth with the saffron and keep it at a bare simmer.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a wide pot. Cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice for 2 minutes until the edges look clear.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring often, until the rice is creamy and just tender.
Take off the heat. Stir in the remaining butter and the Parmesan until glossy.
Season with salt and pepper and serve right away.

recipes.title: Lemon chicken orzo soup
recipes.blurb: Bright, light chicken soup with tender orzo and spinach

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil until soft. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth and chicken and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked, 165°F inside. Remove and shred it.
Add the orzo to the broth.
Cook until the orzo is tender.
Return the chicken, add the spinach, lemon juice and dill, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Stracciatella (Italian egg drop soup)
recipes.blurb: Light Roman broth with ribbons of egg and Parmesan

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the Parmesan, parsley, nutmeg and a pinch of salt.
Bring the broth to a boil in a pot, then lower to a simmer.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Slowly pour in the egg mixture while stirring the soup gently in one direction.
Let the egg set into ribbons.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with more Parmesan.

recipes.title: Tuscan white bean and kale soup
recipes.blurb: Creamy cannellini, kale and rosemary, with a Parmesan rind

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil in a Dutch oven until soft, about 7 minutes.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the beans, broth and rosemary.
Bring to a boil, then simmer.
Mash about a cup of beans against the pot to thicken the soup.
Add the kale and simmer until tender.
Simmer the kale.
Remove the rosemary, stir in the lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper. Serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Caprese salad
recipes.blurb: Ripe tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil with balsamic

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella about a quarter-inch thick.
Overlap the slices on a platter, tucking basil leaves in between.
Drizzle with the olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper just before serving.

recipes.title: Caesar salad with garlic croutons
recipes.blurb: Crisp romaine, creamy lemon dressing and homemade croutons

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Toss the bread with 2 tbsp oil, half the garlic and a pinch of salt.
Bake the croutons on a sheet pan, stirring once, until crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, Worcestershire, remaining garlic, 1 tbsp oil and ¼ cup Parmesan.
Toss the romaine with the dressing until coated.
Top with the croutons, remaining Parmesan and plenty of pepper.

recipes.title: Italian chopped salad
recipes.blurb: Crunchy lettuce, salami, provolone and chickpeas with red wine vinaigrette

steps.text: Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Put the lettuce, chickpeas, salami, provolone, tomatoes, pepperoncini and onion in a large bowl.
Pour on the dressing and toss well.
Taste and add salt and pepper as needed. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Panzanella (Tuscan bread salad)
recipes.blurb: Toasted bread, juicy tomatoes, cucumber and basil

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the bread with 2 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt.
Toast the bread on a sheet pan, stirring once, until crisp and golden.
Mix the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and 1 tsp salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the vinegar, garlic, pepper and the remaining oil.
Add the bread, basil and dressing to the bowl and toss.
Let it sit so the bread soaks up the juices.

recipes.title: Arugula salad with shaved Parmesan
recipes.blurb: Peppery greens, lemon and olive oil in two minutes

steps.text: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the arugula and toss gently.
Top with Parmesan shavings and pine nuts and serve right away.
Add a little more lemon if you want it brighter.

recipes.title: Italian pasta salad
recipes.blurb: Rotini with veggies, olives and mozzarella pearls in Italian dressing

steps.text: Boil the rotini in salted water until al dente.
Drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Toss the pasta with the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, olives and mozzarella.
Add the dressing, Parmesan and seasoning and toss to coat.
Chill so the flavors blend.
Toss again and add a splash more dressing before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy Parmesan polenta
recipes.blurb: Soft, buttery polenta, a cozy base for sauces and braises

steps.text: Bring the water, milk and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Slowly whisk in the polenta in a thin stream so it doesn’t clump.
Lower the heat and cook, stirring every few minutes.
Cook until thick and creamy, adding a splash of water if it gets too stiff.
Stir in the butter and Parmesan, and season with pepper.
Serve hot, right away, as it firms up as it cools.

recipes.title: Italian green beans with tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Fagiolini: tender beans braised with garlic and tomato

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large skillet until soft, about 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomatoes, oregano, ½ tsp salt and pepper.
Add the green beans and stir to coat.
Cover and simmer until the beans are tender.
Uncover and cook a few minutes until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the basil and serve warm.

recipes.title: Sautéed broccoli rabe with garlic
recipes.blurb: Slightly bitter greens with lots of garlic and chili

steps.text: Boil the broccoli rabe in a large pot of salted water.
Boil for 2 minutes to tame the bitterness, then drain well.
Warm the oil, garlic and pepper flakes in a large skillet over medium heat until the garlic is fragrant.
Add the greens and toss.
Cook, stirring, until tender and glossy.
Season with salt and serve with lemon wedges.
